# Skills sync scope -- the SINGLE source for the skills-freshness gate.
#
# Bounded claim: This gate proves the repo skills/ tree equals the manifest
# generated from the repo tree immediately after the last sync copied from
# live -- a consistency claim about the sync's own output, never a freshness
# claim against the live tree (CI cannot see live).
#
# Format: three sections. [skills] lists the in-scope skill directory names
# (directories present in both the repo skills/ tree and the live skills
# tree at derivation time), one per line; membership changes are edits to
# this file, made by PR. [exclude-paths] lists path exclusions: a bare name
# matches any file with that basename, an entry ending in /** matches any
# file whose root-relative path contains that component, and any other
# entry containing / matches only that exact root-relative path.
# [exclude-content] lists literals: a file whose bytes contain any of them
# is excluded when the manifest is generated (and the exclusion is
# reported); at check time a listed file whose bytes contain one is a
# stale manifest entry. Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
# scripts/check_skills_manifest.py parses ALL of its scope and exclusion
# rules from this file; no rule is hardcoded anywhere else.

[skills]
